name: RDT-1B
summary: RDT-1B scales diffusion transformers to 1.2B parameters, pretrains on over a million multi-robot episodes, and fine-tunes on a purpose-collected bimanual dataset. Its key device is a 128-dimensional physically interpretable unified action space where each slot has fixed physical meaning across robots, so one model can absorb single-arm, bimanual and differently configured platforms without discarding structure.
innovation: Unified 128-D action space with fixed physical semantics per dimension for cross-embodiment pretraining.
Scaling diffusion rather than autoregressive policies into the billion-parameter range.
matters: One of the strongest fully open bimanual models, widely used as a base in Chinese robotics labs.
limits: No language-model backbone at RT-2 scale, so semantic generalization is limited.
lineage: Diffusion Policy scaled up and given a cross-embodiment action representation.
